data.narrative:
Foundation Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Sankaet Pathak, Arjun Sethi, and Mike LeBlanc. The company has raised $50M+ and is reportedly seeking $500M at a $3B+ valuation. The peer universe comprises 9 private companies and 1 public entity (277810.KQ). Relevant private comparables include Humanoid ($1.4B Series A), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed).

Two valuation methods triangulate to a range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $50M raised proxy, implying $100M. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector comparables yields $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. The two methods suggest a triangulated valuation range of $85M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $875M.

The wide dispersion reflects significant stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set—Series A comparables like Humanoid command $1.4B, while seed-stage Walden valued at $1.1B. Foundation's Series A stage and $50M+ cumulative capital support valuations in the $800M to $1.2B band, though substantiation hinges on unit economics, technology differentiation, and customer traction relative to benchmarks.
